tasks.userQuery: using "https://github.com/RezaRafia/Speedy" as reference create a windows application that will combine multiple network connection adapters on the OS to combine the speeds of the connection and give a greater & faster bandwidths.
tasks.progress: Completed: CombiSpeed Windows application created with full multi-adapter bonding, dual SOCKS5/HTTP proxy, 1-click Windows System Proxy, real-time telemetry, speed benchmark, and cyberpunk glassmorphic GUI.

checkpoints.inputs: Cloned RezaRafia/Speedy reference repo and analyzed socks.ts, load_balancer.ts, network.ts, App.tsx
checkpoints.outputs: Discovered critical bugs in reference (omitted localAddress socket binding, EADDRINUSE listener port conflict on port 8080, lack of HTTP proxy and Windows proxy integration).

checkpoints.inputs: Executed Get-NetAdapter and verified physical/virtual adapters; executed dual socket test with localAddress binding.
checkpoints.outputs: Verified host has active independent WAN connections: Ethernet 3 (192.168.1.9 -> WAN 106.213.87.143) and Network Bridge/WiFi (192.168.1.28 -> WAN 58.84.61.199). Socket localAddress routing confirmed.
checkpoints.progress: Host environment validated for multi-WAN bonding.

checkpoints.inputs: Initialized Git repository, ToDos.md, KnownIssues.md, version.json
checkpoints.outputs: Core project governance and persistence established.

checkpoints.inputs: Built all core backend services (NetworkDetector, HealthMonitor, LoadBalancer, ProxyServer, WindowsSystemProxyManager, SpeedTester) and full React UI (TitleBar, MasterSwitch, TelemetryStats, ThroughputChart, AdapterCard, SpeedTestModal, AuditLogTable, SettingsModal).
checkpoints.outputs: Full stack compiled and verified with zero errors.
